SUMMARY

Detail-oriented Research Assistant with a strong foundation in experimental psychology and data analytics. Experienced in participant recruitment, survey administration, and statistical software. Proven ability to enhance research efficiency and data quality through methodical protocol implementations.
EXPERIENCE
Undergraduate Research Assistant — Westbrook University Department of Psychology
Sep 2023 – May 2024
• Supported faculty in coordinating a behavioral study with 120+ participants, increasing data collection efficiency by 20%.
• Managed data entry and cleaning processes with SPSS and Excel to ensure 98% data accuracy across multiple datasets.
• Collaborated to develop new survey instruments improving participant response rate by 18%.
• Assisted in literature reviews contributing to preliminary findings presented at the Regional Psychology Symposium.
Summer Research Intern — Nova Behavioral Science Lab
Jun 2023 – Aug 2023
• Conducted cognitive testing sessions using Python-based experimental software with 75+ participants.
• Automated data preprocessing scripts reducing manual task time by 30% and minimizing errors.
• Tracked and documented procedural modifications that improved data consistency for multi-phase studies.
PROJECTS
Cognitive Load Study on Memory Retention
Assisted in designing and executing experiments assessing impacts of multitasking on short-term memory accuracy using controlled tasks and survey tools.
Survey Instrumentation and Participant Engagement
Developed and pilot-tested a new survey instrument targeting student stress factors, increasing valid response yield through improved question clarity.
SKILLS
SPSS  ·  Python (Pandas, NumPy)  ·  Microsoft Excel  ·  Participant Recruitment  ·  Survey Design  ·  Data Cleaning and Analysis  ·  Research Protocol Development
EDUCATION
Westbrook University, B.A. Psychology, Expected May 2025
